documents.title: Receipt accounting date
documents.body: Account for a purchase using the supplier's signed receipt date rather than the payment date.

documents.title: Stale OHLCV recovery
documents.body: When the dashboard price stops advancing, inspect the market data writer and the newest database candle timestamp. A healthy HTTP endpoint alone is insufficient.

documents.title: Concurrent skill definition undo
documents.body: Restoring a previous skill creates a new revision. Reject restoration if another edit occurred after the selected revision.

documents.title: Service release evidence
documents.body: Before declaring a deployment successful, compare the running process working directory, executable checksum and a real business request.

documents.title: Transparent image verification
documents.body: Verify that a PNG has a real alpha channel. A checkerboard painted into an RGB image does not provide transparency.

documents.title: Private knowledge isolation
documents.body: A teammate's private knowledge may only be retrieved for that owner. Membership must be checked before channel knowledge is supplied.

documents.title: Preserve unrelated work
documents.body: When the primary checkout contains uncommitted changes, perform new work in an isolated sibling checkout and preserve the existing edits.

documents.title: Credential materialization
documents.body: Resolve API credentials only when dispatching a request. Never persist credential values in task snapshots, generated documents or event logs.

documents.title: Database backup procedure
documents.body: Create a consistent SQLite backup including committed WAL transactions. Rehearse migration and restoration on a separate copy before changing the original.

documents.title: Late attempt results
documents.body: A cancelled execution must remain cancelled. Fence delayed completion callbacks so an obsolete attempt cannot publish success.

documents.title: Bread fermentation
documents.body: Allow dough to rise at room temperature until doubled before shaping and baking.

documents.title: Balcony tomato care
documents.body: Tomatoes need sunlight, regular watering and well drained soil.

documents.title: TN001 device identity
documents.body: TN001 is the device identifier used in the DCS MQTT report.
